description: The overall average budget amount is the average amount over all budget lines, so events with more lines weigh more.

a.request: For each event in the budget table (`budget.link_to_event`), work out the average budgeted `amount` across its budget lines, ignoring missing amounts. Take the overall average as the mean amount over all budget lines, so events with more lines weigh more, and keep only the events whose average is above it. For each such event, show the event link, its average amount, how far that is above the overall average, and its average minus the mean of the kept events' averages. Sort by this last difference, largest first, and show the top 10.
a.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg FROM budget), kept AS (SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount, ev.avg_amount - overall.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM ev CROSS JOIN overall WHERE ev.avg_amount > overall.overall_avg) SELECT link_to_event, avg_amount, above_overall, avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM kept) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10

b.request: Events whose average budget line amount (per `budget.link_to_event`, ignoring NULL amounts) exceeds the overall average amount across all budget lines (each line weighted equally, so events with more lines weigh more) are listed with their event link, average amount, difference from the overall line-level average, and difference from the mean of those above-average events' averages, with the top 10 by that last gap shown, largest first
b.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL), above AS (SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount, overall.overall_avg FROM ev, overall WHERE ev.avg_amount > overall.overall_avg), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_above FROM above) SELECT a.link_to_event, a.avg_amount, a.avg_amount - a.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg, a.avg_amount - m.mean_above AS diff_from_mean_above FROM above a, m ORDER BY diff_from_mean_above DESC LIMIT 10

c.request: Which events have an above-average budget amount? For each event (`budget.link_to_event`), using the average `amount` across its budget lines and ignoring missing amounts, show the event link, its average amount, how much it beats the overall average budget amount, and its average minus the mean among those above-average events. List the top 10 by that last gap, largest first. The overall average budget amount is the average amount over all budget lines, so events with more lines weigh more.
c.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg FROM budget), above AS (SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount, overall.overall_avg FROM ev CROSS JOIN overall WHERE ev.avg_amount > overall.overall_avg) SELECT link_to_event, avg_amount, avg_amount - overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg, avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM above) AS diff_from_above_avg_mean FROM above ORDER BY diff_from_above_avg_mean DESC LIMIT 10

d.request: Which events have an above-average budget amount? For each event (`budget.link_to_event`), compute the average `amount` across its budget lines, ignoring missing amounts. Compare that to the overall average budget amount, defined as the average `amount` over all budget lines (so events with more lines weigh more). Show the event link, its average amount, how much it exceeds the overall average, and its average minus the mean average among the above-average events. List the top 10 by that last gap, largest first.
d.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amt FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS oa FROM budget), above AS (SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amt, ev.avg_amt - overall.oa AS exceeds FROM ev, overall WHERE ev.avg_amt > overall.oa), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS mean_above FROM above) SELECT a.link_to_event, a.avg_amt AS average_amount, a.exceeds AS exceeds_overall_average, a.avg_amt - m.mean_above AS gap_from_mean_above FROM above a, m ORDER BY gap_from_mean_above DESC LIMIT 10
